headline: Purbaya Reveals Whoosh Debt Installments of Rp1 Trillion with an 80-Year Tenor
summary: Finance Minister Purbaya said the Jakarta-Bandung high-speed railway (KCJB) debt, known as Whoosh, will be repaid in installments of about Rp1 trillion a year over a tenor of up to 80 years.
why: KCJB is Indonesia's first high-speed rail line, and its debt burden affects state finances and the state-owned companies involved. Repayment terms shape investor views on Indonesian infrastructure debt.
